races.name: Bermingham Cameras Novice Chase
midfield: Uno Me I Like My T

runners_data.name: Sky Lord
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid chase form who should relish the patient pace scenario this race will provide.
runners_data.comment: Beaten favourite at Cork in his first handicap chase, needs to raise his game, tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 130 after five runs over fences without winning; beaten favourite at Cork on handicap chase debut (2m1f, good to yielding); 25l behind in a big-field Listed handicap chase here last time; needs to raise his game but could be best placed to take advantage if the top-rated disappoints.

runners_data.name: Supersundae
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up type returning to form after Kilbeggan win, perfectly suited to tracking Ma Jacks Hill's sustainable tempo.
runners_data.comment: Easy chase winner at Kilbeggan last time; penalised 6lb but should still be hard to beat
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner placed in a Grade 1 before losing his form last year; blasted back to somewhere near his best when landing a Kilbeggan beginners' chase (2m7f, good to yielding) by 17l in April; 2m at Wexford was too sharp for him when 7.5l behind the winner in second, carrying a penalty; rider reduces penalty here and he's undoubtedly the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Ma Jacks Hill
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who'll lead throughout but may struggle to resist sustained pressure from classier hold-up horses in the finish.
runners_data.comment: Point/m'den hurdle winner was just fair in h'cap hurdles last twice; work to do
runners_data.spotlight: Won his second point-to-point after unseating in his first; 1-5 over hurdles after landing a Gowran maiden in October (2m1f, soft) and is rated 120 over smaller obstacles; some encouragement in his chase debut at Limerick last time when an 18.5l third; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Jolie Jewel
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare building on positive chasing debut, benefits from 5lb claim and the likely tactical nature of this small field.
runners_data.comment: Wins over 2m3f and 2m4f over hurdles, this trip may be on the sharp side on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual winning hurdler is rated 115 in that sphere; made a positive chasing debut at Ballinrobe last time when third and shaping as though the 2m1f offered by the race was inadequate; can improve but will need to do so radically in this company.

runners_data.name: Uno Me I Like My T
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but completely out of her depth on form, returning from a 374-day absence with concerning fade tendency.
runners_data.spotlight: All her form in maiden hurdles, points and a bumper says she's out of her depth here.

races.paceDynamic: Ma Jacks Hill will dictate from the front with his prominent style, setting a sustainable gallop that won't trouble the field early. With only five runners and no other confirmed pace angles, this becomes a tactical affair where the pace will be moderate throughout. The hold-up horses Sky Lord, Supersundae, Jolie Jewel and Uno Me I Like My T will all be tracking behind looking for their moment. This controlled tempo strongly favours the patient hold-up performers who can unleash their finishing kicks in the final half-mile when Ma Jacks Hill comes under pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill sets an honest but manageable pace allowing trackers to conserve energy.
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop enables the class horses Sky Lord and Supersundae to produce their best finishing efforts when Ma Jacks Hill weakens. Both have the tactical speed to pick off the leader in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses fail to coordinate their challenges.
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage while the closers leave their runs too late or get in each other's way. Ma Jacks Hill's stamina proves decisive over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Improver Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Jolie Jewel's chasing debut momentum carries her past more established rivals.
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced mare builds on her positive Ballinrobe third with continued improvement, while the favourites underperform. Her fresher profile gives her the edge in a slowly-run contest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish that doesn't suit anyone.
scenarios.body: The crawling pace sets up a lottery where tactical positioning matters more than class or form. The race becomes a messy scramble where any of the five could prevail on the day.

watchPoints.text: Uno Me I Like My T looks completely outclassed and her 374-day layoff suggests she's here for experience rather than victory.
Ma Jacks Hill's front-running style could see him build a dangerous lead if the hold-up horses are too patient behind.
Sky Lord has been beaten favourite recently and needs to show he can convert good positions into victories.
Supersundae carries top weight but his class edge should tell if he gets the patient ride this race shape suggests.
Watch for Jolie Jewel to be produced with a late run, building on her encouraging chasing debut at Ballinrobe.

races.name: Jim Ryan Memorial Novice Chase

runners_data.name: Emily Love
runners_data.note: Front-runner facing no pace pressure with Kevin Sexton's 7-day claim, only 8 days since last run but proven effective when fresh over similar trips.
runners_data.comment: 129-rated hurdler; wouldn't have won but running well when falling on her chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Likes a sound surface and was prolific over hurdles (rated 129) last year, winning five times at up to 2m4f, including a fast-ground victory in America; was running a good race when coming down on chasing debut; benefitted from fall of odds-on favourite when winning over 2m at Tramore, not having much to spare over 112-rated rival.

runners_data.name: Raglan Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying 164lbs after 37-day break, needs to overcome slow early pace that favours front-runners but has class edge from festival experience.
runners_data.comment: Well backed to win rated novice chase last time; likely capable of more
runners_data.spotlight: 131-rated hurdler was third to Wodhoodh in last year's Martin Pipe; won rated chase off 124 at Down Royal, pulled up in valuable novice handicap at the festival here last month; pulled up over hurdles on sole previous try over 3m, but that was on bad ground.

runners_data.name: Yoradreamer
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with 7lb claimer Anna McGuinness aboard, 37 days off but built stamina winning over this trip when making all at Wexford last time.
runners_data.comment: Form of easy beginners' chase win last time doesn't amount to much, but not ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden winner over hurdles, rated 118; promise in good beginners' at Gowran and built on that to win four-runner affair over this trip at Wexford, making all; didn't get far in novice handicap at the festival here (hampered and unseated rider) for which he was 40s and Raglan Road was 18/1; wins have come on easy ground, but he handles good.

races.paceDynamic: Emily Love will be the only committed pace-setter in this small three-runner field, making all the running without pressure from the start. Yoradreamer may sit prominently but is unlikely to challenge for the early lead, while Raglan Road will settle at the back as a hold-up horse. With Emily Love setting her own fractions unchallenged over 3m1f, this creates an ideal tactical scenario for the front-runner to dictate terms throughout. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can control the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Emily Love Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If Emily Love jumps cleanly and sets her own pace from the front.
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions without pressure and kick clear when ready, making maximum use of her front-running style. Her hurdles form shows she's effective when allowed to dominate, and the lack of pace pressure plays directly into her hands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If Raglan Road's stamina and jumping proves superior in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: The slow pace allows him to close strongly from the back despite giving Emily Love a head start. His hold-up style could be effective if the others go too slow early and he has enough class to reel them in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Yoradreamer Times Run
scenarios.trigger: If Yoradreamer can track Emily Love and outstay her from the last fence.
scenarios.body: His prominent position allows him to monitor Emily Love's effort while keeping his powder dry for a late surge. The Mullins runner could benefit if Emily Love's front-running tactics backfire in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If multiple jumping mistakes or falls disrupt the expected running order.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of who can jump most accurately under pressure when tired. Any significant blunder by Emily Love would completely change the complexion with so few runners.

watchPoints.text: Emily Love's jumping fluency early - any mistakes will invite pressure she's not facing tactically
Raglan Road's position turning for home - if too far back when Emily Love kicks, the race could be over
Yoradreamer's willingness to press Emily Love early - could create the pace pressure needed to stop a front-running rout
The pace through the first circuit - if genuinely crawling, it brings Raglan Road's class and stamina into play
How the 7lb claims ride their races - both McGuinness and Sexton need to time their efforts perfectly in this tactical affair

races.name: K-Mech Mechanical Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Jalila Moriviere
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent form who will benefit from patient pace and good to soft conditions
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; trounced weak opposition on chase debut at Sligo in October on good to yielding; ran a nice race in a Grade 3 Thurles novice chase in March (2m6f, soft) and bounced back from a poor effort at Fairyhouse when a distant second of 20 in a 2m1f Listed contest last time; firmly in the mix.

runners_data.name: Captain Conby
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long layoff but showed sharpness on recent Flat return
runners_data.comment: Should be sharper now following a comeback on the Flat, had very useful form in 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Had very useful form in 2023 and looked sharper for his Flat return after 851 days off the track when a 12l sixth of ten at Wexford (2m, good to yielding); on a nice mark if continuing to shake off his rustiness.

runners_data.name: Me Wee Bonnie Lass
runners_data.note: Strong staying chaser suited by hold-up tactics and proven on similar ground conditions
runners_data.comment: Was 10l winner of Listed mares' handicap at Fairyhouse; 8lb higher now; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; three-time winning hurdler got off the mark over fences in some style when 10l winner of Listed mares' handicap at Fairyhouse (2m5f, yielding to soft); 8lb higher now, but big player if that win wasn't an aberration.

runners_data.name: Karoline Banbou
runners_data.note: Likely leader but poor jumping record makes her vulnerable despite uncontested lead potential
runners_data.comment: Second on both completed starts over fences, bids to make amends now for Leopardstown fall
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; beaten favourite in all four beginners' chase starts, the latest of which when 33l behind at Wexford after some jumps lacking in fluency; hard to trust and probably wants softer, but she's dangerous if putting it all together.

runners_data.name: Mister Pink
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may lack the class but benefits from good recent form
runners_data.comment: Moderate in two starts over fences since returning from over a year off; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; three beginners' chase runs for new yard back from a break haven't been much to shout about; may do better now in a handicap with an opening mark 7lb below his hurdles one.

runners_data.name: Listentillitellyea
runners_data.note: Prominent chaser with poor fence record running just 24 hours after last appearance
runners_data.comment: 0-9 over fences, good ground not ideal latest, rain a plus but others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Has won over hurdles but is 0-9 over fences; ground given as possible excuse for 45l defeat at Ballinrobe (2m1f, good) on return from 295-day break on latest; forecast rain a plus and has run respectably here before but others hold more pressing claims; sixth in 1.50 here on Saturday.

runners_data.name: He's Gorgeous
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Grade 1 experience who should appreciate the patient pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Fine fifth of 22 in deep 2m4f novice handicap at Punchestown; good chance if he stays
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't hang around over hurdles and won the second of his beginners' chase starts at Clonmel (2m2f, heavy) in December; fourth of nine in Grade 1 company next time at Leopardstown; kept plugging away when fine fifth of 22 in deep novice handicap at Punchestown festival in May (2m4f, yielding); never involved when favourite in a better Ballinrobe contest last time; blinkers go on, and he's of interest if they sharpen him.

runners_data.name: Ocastle Des Mottes
runners_data.note: French import yet to fire for Mullins but dangerous if recapturing best hurdles form
runners_data.comment: Entitled to come on for first run back at Cork after over a year off and Townend rides
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; dual French hurdles winner is yet to score for this yard but has run well in defeat at times, including when runner-up at Punchestown on chasing debut (2m3f, soft); returned from over a year off at Cork (2m1f, yielding) when 23l fourth behind better-fancied stablemate; makes handicap chase debut now.

runners_data.name: Dutch Schultz
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose best chase form came in similar conditions at Killarney
runners_data.comment: Not a bad run at Fairyhouse after a break, Come On The Lads seems to be yard's number one
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; most recent of two chase wins came in a 2m1f Killarney handicap chase in August 2024; moderate efforts in the autumn and two outings back from a break haven't been much better.

runners_data.name: The Gradual Slope
runners_data.note: Recent winner suited by prominent tactics but faces 5lb rise in handicap mark
runners_data.comment: Won a Fairyhouse handicap over 2m5f last time; up 5lb so will have to do more; 1lb wrong
runners_data.spotlight: Recorded first win since 2024 when taking a Fairyhouse handicap over 2m5f last time despite jumping right late on; raised 5lb for that so will have to raise his game again, but has won off 4lb higher in the past.

runners_data.name: El Champo
runners_data.note: Prominent chaser with stamina doubts despite dual-winning record over fences
runners_data.comment: Third reserve, winner of five races, up against it after two failures to complete
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-winning chaser whose last win came at Listowel in September off 1lb lower (2m6f, good to yielding); looks up against it based on a failure to complete at Gowran over fences and Fairyhouse over hurdles before finishing tailed off here last time.

runners_data.name: Vaureal
runners_data.note: Consistent performer who ran well in cross-country company and handles testing ground
runners_data.comment: Just denied in recent Fairyhouse handicap; claims on earlier C&D fifth in stronger company
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a head by The Gradual Slope at Fairyhouse in April (2m5f, yielding to soft); creditable effort around the cross-country course at the Punchestown festival last time (3m1f, good to yielding); not ruled out.

runners_data.name: Glenashling
runners_data.note: Maiden chase winner with prominent style but faces significant step up in class
runners_data.comment: Second in a six-runner handicap at Cork, officially rated 11lb inferior to Karoline Banbou
runners_data.spotlight: One of three for trainer; maiden hurdle winner early last year; runner-up in six-runner Cork contest (2m1f, good to yielding) on handicap chase debut in April; another creditable effort back in a beginners' chase at Wexford (2m, good to yielding) last time, when well ahead of Mister Pink and Karoline Banbou.

races.paceDynamic: Karoline Banbou will likely lead with Mister Pink, The Gradual Slope, and Listentillitellyea tracking in prominent positions. This creates a moderate tempo over the extended trip, with no genuine speed horses to inject serious pace pressure. The bulk of the field including Jalila Moriviere, Captain Conby, Me Wee Bonnie Lass, He's Gorgeous, and Dutch Schultz will sit further back looking to mount late challenges. This patient pace scenario clearly favours hold-up horses who can unleash finishing kicks, as the leaders won't establish enough of an advantage to hold off late challengers over this stamina-testing distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Karoline Banbou sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and time their challenges perfectly in the closing stages. Strong stayers with tactical speed will prove superior to the exposed front-runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Karoline Banbou finds significant improvement and the chasers fail to close
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on good jumping ground and builds an unassailable advantage when the pace quickens. Late challengers leave their moves too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and tactical positioning becomes crucial
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the leader in the perfect stalking positions can kick clear before the hold-up brigade gets organized. The race becomes a sprint finish favouring those already in contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fancied runners make jumping errors or the pace becomes chaotic
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with several non-finishers, allowing an unconsidered runner to pick up the pieces. Form gets thrown out the window in favour of a clean jumper.

watchPoints.text: Karoline Banbou's jumping accuracy early on - her fluency issues could create chaos for those tracking close behind
The pace through the first mile - if genuinely slow it will significantly favour the prominent runners over pure hold-up horses
Jalila Moriviere's jumping on chase return - any rustiness could cost vital ground in what may become a sprint finish
Captain Conby's fitness levels after 851-day layoff - stamina reserves may be tested over this extended trip
Weather conditions before racing - any further rain could swing the advantage towards proven soft ground performers

races.name: Congratulations Nicole Lockhead Anderson INHSC Ladies Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Act Of God
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 1012-day absence, massive fitness concern despite point-to-point prep
runners_data.comment: Old boy had a good career across the codes for the late Edward O'Grady; here for the spin
runners_data.spotlight: Old boy had a good career across the codes for the late Edward O'Grady; had been out of action since summer of 2023 until resuming in point-to-points last month.

runners_data.name: Fenway Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who beat Qaasid in receipt of weight, headgear change could sharpen him up
runners_data.comment: Entitled to win claiming hurdle last time and nicely weighted here too; big player
runners_data.spotlight: In receipt of plenty of weight from Qaasid when beating that rival in claimer at Clonmel in February; remote second in another claimer a week later; headgear removed for stable debut.

runners_data.name: Cut The Rope
runners_data.note: Prominent racer struggling since bumper win, needs to bounce back from poor Naas effort
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner on debut, yet to add to that; his fifth of 23 in 2m4f Leopardstown handicap over Christmas would give him a chance; well beaten on bad ground next time; had a spin on the Flat last month.

runners_data.name: Costanuci
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse off 194 days, three-time hurdle winner but recent form disappointing
runners_data.comment: C&D winner in 2023 but recent form leaves her with plenty to find
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdle winner in 2023; couple of good runs over fences last summer; poor efforts over hurdles last two starts and off since November.

runners_data.name: That's About Right
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to hurdles after chasing, first run over timber since 2024
runners_data.spotlight: Three hurdle wins but this is his first run in this discipline since 2024; couple of fair runs over fences this year and will like the ground.

runners_data.name: Lakewood Rose
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with consistent recent form, only beaten 3 lengths last time at Wexford
runners_data.comment: Well held in a Tramore handicap off 1lb higher last time; improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner has been fourth in first two handicaps and only beaten around 3l over 2m4f at Wexford last time.

runners_data.name: Digby
runners_data.note: Prominent racer wearing cheekpieces, unpredictable but showed more interest in visor last time
runners_data.comment: Last year's winner off 9lb higher, in poor form recently, new headgear tried; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Has become hard to predict but travelled a bit better than he often does when fifth in a first-time visor at Ballinrobe; cheekpieces back on now and trip looks too sharp.

runners_data.name: Icare Desbois
runners_data.note: Key pace angle, former Mullins horse whose form has declined but will ensure decent gallop
runners_data.comment: Now looks regressive and was behind some of these at Killarney three weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly useful for Wille Mullins and ran okay in Flat maidens in the autumn, but his recent hurdles form has been poor and mark on the slide.

runners_data.name: Hidalgo Des Mottes
runners_data.note: Prominent type who is long-standing maiden, wearing tongue-strap for first time
runners_data.comment: Maiden is best on a sound surface so won't want too much rain; could run well
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of placed efforts but is a long-standing maiden over hurdles; fair Flat run last month; only 11-2 at Clonmel on Friday, but was soundly beaten.

runners_data.name: Mary's Pride
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with fade-in-finish concern, best over shorter trips than this 2m3f test
runners_data.comment: 6lb below last win, lacks a run but has gone well fresh, cheekpieces on, can't dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Best form is over 2m and previous attempts over around 2m4f haven't worked out; can go well fresh which he again demonstrated at Ballinrobe, but not sure to back that up.

runners_data.name: Lord Ffrench
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with promising rider booking, probably needed reappearance at Cork
runners_data.comment: Better than he showed in his previous run in a handicap; has been off since October
runners_data.spotlight: Won modest 2m5f maiden in Sligo last summer; well beaten in two handicap starts, but probably needed return; rider has had a fine year in point-to-points.

runners_data.name: Qaasid
runners_data.note: Hold-up type coming off controversial Limerick win, proven at this level with tactical speed
runners_data.comment: Five Flat wins, 0-11 hurdling, leading when slipped up going to three out at Clonmel
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain; rightly got controversial 2m4f Limerick handicap hurdle in the stewards' room after being badly hampered by the first past the post; finished off well that day and likely drier ground here is a positive.

runners_data.name: Cock And Bull
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner.

runners_data.name: Fortunate Lighting
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who won over 2m5f last summer, disappointing chase debut can excuse
runners_data.comment: Rated 111 over hurdles and has a bit to find with some of these on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won 2m5f Sligo handicap on good ground last summer and her reappearance fifth at Bellewstown wasn't a bad effort over a trip too short; tailed off on chase debut last month.

runners_data.name: Adaliz
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 306-day break, dual summer winner who handles good ground well
runners_data.spotlight: Two handicap wins on nice ground last summer, over a similar trip to this at Clonmel and then over nearly 3m at Tipperary; off 10 months.

runners_data.name: Fairlander
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making handicap debut, ran well when third at Down Royal over similar trip
runners_data.comment: Much improved on h'cap debut latest, this tougher and 2lb wrong but can't dismiss
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a decent point and ran well on handicap debut when third of 19 at Down Royal (2m4f, yielding) in March; well held at the festival here, but should be competitive back down in grade

runners_data.name: Goin'
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with Flat background, experienced pilot takes over for first hurdle handicap
runners_data.spotlight: Fair performer on the Flat (rated 68) and his latest two runs in that sphere have been fine; experienced rider on board for handicap debut .

races.paceDynamic: Icare Desbois will take this along at a sustainable gallop with Mary's Pride, Adaliz and Digby likely to track the pace. With only one confirmed front runner and several prominent racers, the early pace should be honest but not frantic. The strong stamina test of 2m3f at Punchestown will see the race develop into a proper staying test from the back straight. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce a late challenge, as the pace will set up perfectly for closers to sweep past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the race becomes a stamina test from two out
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the early pace-setters, allowing the patient hold-up brigade to pick off tired leaders. Horses with tactical speed who can quicken off the strong pace will have every chance to get competitive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Mary's Pride or Adaliz can get into an ideal tracking position behind Icare Desbois
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a tactical affair where horses just off the pace can time their challenges perfectly. Those who avoid the early burn-up but stay close enough to strike will benefit from others' pace efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Running Pays Off
scenarios.trigger: If Icare Desbois gets an uncontested lead and the pace becomes too slow early
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear when it matters. Late closers will struggle to make up ground if the tempo doesn't suit their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Icare Desbois weakens early and no other pace angle emerges
scenarios.body: The race becomes a muddling affair where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize. Form horses with tactical speed from any position could benefit from the lack of a true pace test.

watchPoints.text: Icare Desbois must take them along or this becomes a tactical crawl that suits nobody
Mary's Pride has finishing concerns over this extended trip and may not see out 2m3f
Act Of God returning from massive layoff, watch market confidence for fitness clues
Adaliz returning from 10-month absence but has proven class at this level when fit
Several conditional jockeys claiming 7lb could make significant difference in tight handicap

races.name: Lily & Wild Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners_data.name: Hello Below
runners_data.note: Unknown style but P-t-P background suggests stamina; 15-day break reasonable for debut handler Colin Bowe
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 in points but runner-up in her last two outings; makes hurdling debut now for top point-to-point handler.

runners_data.name: Likeyouhaveplenty
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with poor jumping history; 49-day break concerning for jumping confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Poor jumping on show when pulled up at Tramore; hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Royal Order
runners_data.note: Unknown style on debut; breeding suggests stamina but unlikely immediate impact for 1/26 trainer
runners_data.spotlight: Dam 2m4f hurdle winner, half-sister to 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Benefit Run, out of 2m/2m1f chase winner; unlikely to make an immediate impact.

runners_data.name: Barstool Prophet
runners_data.note: Unknown style with finishing concerns; 40-day break and 0-rated bumper form worrying
runners_data.comment: E30,000 3yo, third foal; dam a bumper/chase winner by Kings Theatre; cheekpieces fitted
runners_data.spotlight: Purchased for 30,000euros as a 3yo; Crystal Ocean filly showed nothing on bumper debut here and needs to take a big step forward.

runners_data.name: Fennors Rose
runners_data.note: Unknown style on debut; half-sister to useful hurdler provides some hope for new handler
runners_data.spotlight: Jukebox Jury filly; unsold for 10,500euros as foal; half-sister to six winners inc Fennor Cross (1m-10.3f Flat, RPR 87; useful 2m-2m4f hurdle), Dune Buggy (Italian 8.5f-9.5f) and Infinity Focus (Italian 7.5f-11.4f inc 2yo); dam unraced half-sister to useful 1m2f winner Nurture; likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Free A Minute
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with winless P-t-P record; 62-day break after poor bumper form
runners_data.comment: 0-5 in points and yet to trouble the judge, dam related to bumper winners, others stronger

races.paceDynamic: Prophetess Miriam stands alone as the confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner maiden hurdle, with her established leading style likely to dictate terms from the flag. Bold Reflection, Some Pretender, and Julie Liath are the main prominent racers who could press early, but none are natural pace-pressers. This sets up a controlled gallop that will gradually intensify from the back straight, with the real test coming in the final half-mile as the hold-up horses make their moves. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close enough to strike, as pure hold-up horses will face a wall of traffic in the straight with 19 runners funneling down.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Prophetess Miriam leads unchallenged through steady fractions and the pace only quickens from three out.
scenarios.body: The established form horses get ideal conditions to show their superior class, with Some Pretender and Julie Liath perfectly positioned to strike. Working Away and Crossbar Getaway benefit from the strong gallop that exposes the weaker maidens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Bold Reflection or Julie Liath press Prophetess Miriam early and create genuine pace pressure from halfway.
scenarios.body: The strong gallop sets up perfectly for closers with proven stamina, allowing Between Friends and Crossbar Getaway to unleash finishing kicks. The early leaders weaken, opening the door for horses with tactical speed to come through.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady until the straight, then quickens sharply when the field bunches for the final hurdle.
scenarios.body: Horses that can quicken off the bridle gain crucial advantages in the sprint finish, with Some Pretender's class and Bold Reflection's freshness proving decisive. The pure hold-up horses get caught flat-footed by the sudden injection of pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace materializes throughout and the extended trip becomes a true staying test.
scenarios.body: The marathon conditions expose the inexperienced runners and favour horses with proven stamina reserves like Julie Liath and Between Friends. Working Away's point-to-point background becomes an asset in the grueling finish.

watchPoints.text: Prophetess Miriam's early fractions will determine the entire race shape - if she goes too fast early, the field compresses dangerously

Some Pretender has clear class edge from Galway win but must prove she handles this step up in distance

races.paceDynamic: Ajp Falco is the only confirmed front runner in this maiden hurdle field and should be allowed an uncontested lead through the early stages. With most runners holding prominent or hold-up styles, the pace is likely to be steady rather than searching, allowing Ajp Falco to dictate terms without pressure until the business end. The lack of natural pace-pressers means this will develop into a sprint finish from the home turn, with the final half-mile proving decisive. This tactical setup clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid the front-running burden that has seen Ajp Falco fade late in recent efforts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ajp Falco gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the front runner to reserve energy for a sustained kick, while hold-up horses find themselves too far back when the tempo finally lifts approaching the final flight. The prominent runners get first run but can't peg back a horse who has controlled every aspect of the race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens from halfway and Ajp Falco begins to weaken
scenarios.body: Jerry From Kerry and Le Questionnaire emerge as the main threats approaching the home turn, with their class and recent form advantage telling against the exposed front runner. The hold-up horses struggle to make up ground as the race develops into a staying test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a crawling affair
scenarios.body: Captain Hanley and other hold-up runners benefit from a sprint finish that negates stamina concerns and allows their turn of foot to prove decisive. The early leaders find themselves swamped by a wall of finishers who have conserved energy for one final effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses make mistakes at crucial hurdles late in the race
scenarios.body: The disruption to the fancied runners' momentum allows one of the lesser-fancied but more experienced types to slip through and capitalize on a messy finish. Course experience and jumping reliability become the determining factors over pure ability.

races.paceDynamic: Maverick Mack will lead this field from the start with no obvious challenger for the early pace, creating a comfortable gallop through the first half of this 2m7½f test. The prominent runners like Jackmoon, Ottoman Style, and William Tell will track him at a respectful distance, while the hold-up brigade including Good World, Beyond Your Dreams, and Morell River settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front runner and a trip that demands stamina, this sets up perfectly for horses that can stay well and finish strongly from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack sets a pedestrian early pace and the race becomes a staying test from the back.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the patient riders to produce their horses with late runs, turning it into a stamina battle where trip specialists thrive. Good World and Morell River benefit most from this scenario with their proven staying ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trackers strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens approaching the home turn and the race develops into a tactical battle.
scenarios.body: William Tell and Ottoman Style can use their class and tactical speed to strike before the stamina test fully kicks in. Their prominent positions give them first run on the leaders while avoiding the traffic that may hinder those further back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack crawls in front and the race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle.
scenarios.body: The lack of any genuine pace through the race means it becomes about who has the most tactical speed rather than stamina. This favors the horses with best recent form who can produce a sharp turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front runner lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Maverick Mack gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to organize a serious challenge.
scenarios.body: His recent point win suggests he has some ability, and if the pace is truly moderate, he might just have enough in reserve to hold on. The lack of early pressure could work in his favor despite his modest hurdles form.

races.paceDynamic: Coco's Legacy will take them along from the front with her confirmed lead style, creating a sustainable gallop that won't be pressured early. Al Arrivee and Brave Lady may track in prominent positions, but neither is aggressive enough to challenge the early tempo. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this will become a staying test in the final half-mile rather than a sprint finish. This moderate tempo strongly favours hold-up horses who can unleash late runs and prominent runners with tactical speed over pure front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and no one challenges Coco's Legacy early
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop sets up perfectly for hold-up runners to deliver sustained finishes, with Hope And Mercy and Saoirses Choice able to pick off tiring leaders. Late-running types get the ideal scenario to showcase their stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tells Up Front

scenarios.body: The higher-rated prominent runners use their superior class to position themselves perfectly and outstay the opposition in a tactical finish. Their proven form at this level becomes decisive when the race develops into a stamina test.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-To-Wire Success
scenarios.trigger: If Coco's Legacy gets completely uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable advantage through fractions that suit her perfectly, with the lack of early pressure allowing her to save enough energy for the finish. Her Downpatrick win shows she can sustain a gallop when unopposed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very slow and one of the unconsidered runners produces an unexpected finish
scenarios.body: The crawling tempo allows a lightly-raced type like Are You There or False Dawn to spring a surprise with fresh legs and untapped ability. The tactical nature catches the fancied runners napping.

watchPoints.text: Coco's Legacy must be monitored for any early pressure as she needs uncontested lead to be effective
Hope And Mercy returning from long break may need time to find fitness despite good going conditions
Al Arrivee carries 7lb penalty and must prove she can handle the weight against these mares
Any News For Me and Big Budgie both show fading tendencies that could be magnified after long breaks
Are You There and False Dawn represent unknown quantities whose debut runs will reveal true ability levels
